name: Oregonator
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
  <RD format_version="2">
  
    <description>
      The two-variable <a href="http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oregonator">Oregonator</a> 
      model of the <a href="http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Belousov-Zhabotinsky_reaction">Belousov–Zhabotinsky reaction</a>.
    </description>
    
    <rule name="Oregonator" type="formula" wrap="0">
      <param name="timestep">       0.0001        </param>
      <param name="D_a">            1             </param>
      <param name="D_b">            0.6           </param>
      <param name="epsilon">        0.01          </param>
      <param name="f">              1.4           </param>
      <param name="q">              0.002         </param>
      <formula number_of_chemicals="2">
        delta_a = D_a * laplacian_a + (a - a*a - f*b*(a-q)/(a+q))/epsilon;
        delta_b = D_b * laplacian_b + a - b;
      </formula>
    </rule>
    
    <initial_pattern_generator apply_when_loading="true">
      <overlay chemical="b">
        <overwrite />
        <linear_gradient val1="0" val2="0.2">
          <point3D x="0.2" y="0.5" z="0.5" />
          <point3D x="0.6" y="0.5" z="0.5" />
        </linear_gradient>
        <rectangle>
          <point3D x="0.2" y="0.45" z="0.5" />
          <point3D x="0.6" y="0.55" z="0.5" />
        </rectangle>
      </overlay>
    </initial_pattern_generator>
    
    <render_settings>
      <color_low r="0" g="0" b="1" />
      <color_high r="1" g="0" b="0" />
      <show_color_scale value="true" />
      <show_multiple_chemicals value="true" />
      <active_chemical value="b" />
      <low value="0" />
      <high value="1" />
      <show_displacement_mapped_surface value="false" />
      <timesteps_per_render value="3200" />
    </render_settings>
    
  </RD>
  <ImageData WholeExtent="0 255 0 255 0 0"></ImageData>
</VTKFile>
